title: ValidationResult
description: Outcome of one Rust validate job attempt on a draft (OQ-02 section 4). It runs the shared strategy validator, checks that the longest lookback fits the cohort warm-up and recomputes the leaf difference from the parent. draft_digest is the digest of the draft strategy-artefact/1 the job read; it is not a Strategy Version hash, because no version is registered before validation passes. An accepted VALID or INVALID result makes the job COMPLETED. A VALID result registers the Strategy Version in DRAFT. A draft that fails validation receives diagnostics, not critique; they go to the next proposer attempt, and no Strategy Version is registered from it. duration is the attempt duration that the batch host measured; the API settles the attempt's compute reservation from it (OQ-05 section 4).

ValidDefinition.title: ValidDefinition
ValidDefinition.description: computed_changes is the leaf difference from the parent that Rust computed; it equals the declared changes. It is empty when the version has no parent. change_scope classifies computed_changes by dependency (OQ-02 section 3.1).

ChangeScope.title: ChangeScope
ChangeScope.description: Which rules computed_changes affects, by dependency (OQ-02 section 3.1). A change under /definition/entry affects the entry rule and a change under /definition/exits the exit rules. A changed indicator counts as a change to every rule that references it, directly or through other indicators. A change under /definition/selection, /definition/sizing or /definition/execution, or to an indicator that no entry or exit rule references, is outside a controlled revision. The first value that applies is the scope: NONE when there is no change, as for a version without a parent; OUTSIDE_SCOPE when any change is outside a controlled revision; BOTH when the changes affect the entry rule and the exit rules; otherwise ENTRY or EXIT. Under the cohort policy revision_scope ENTRY_OR_EXIT, only ENTRY or EXIT registers a revision; BOTH, OUTSIDE_SCOPE and NONE do not.

ValidationDiagnostic.title: ValidationDiagnostic
ValidationDiagnostic.description: pointer is a JSON Pointer into the strategy artefact, or empty for the whole artefact.

ValidationCode.title: ValidationCode
ValidationCode.description: Strategy failure codes of the shared validator, plus the derived checks. LOOKBACK_EXCEEDS_WARMUP: the longest lookback is longer than the warm-up. LINEAGE_MISMATCH: the declared changes differ from the computed leaf difference. IDENTITY_MISMATCH: a hash does not match its artefact.
